protocol.arm_rule: A unrestricted; B/C/D request the lowest-numbered 4/2/1 active guest logical processors
protocol.criteria: affinity set/verification failure, timeout, decode error, invalid geometry or metadata => INVALID; any pixel hash difference => REFERENCE_DECODER_NONDETERMINISTIC; stable output without encoder pair remains UNRESOLVED
protocol.confirmatory_trigger: run fresh 9-process arms in reversed order when arm A and any reduced arm differ in stability direction or by at least 5/45 divergent calls
